_about: Hellhound Derby dialogue. {t} = the hound being talked to, {a} / {b} = the hounds in an event, {o} = what the crowd threw. trash: said by a hound passing another; retort: the answer; at: aimed at one hound; by: a hound's own voice; react: what a hound says in an event; ticker: the commentary line for an event (several per event, one picked at random). thrown: what a hound says about the junk that just hit it, tripped it or nearly did, one list per thing (the names in JUNK); eaten: what Bubba says when he eats it instead. The 'clean language' setting turns the swearing into #@$%. hot / cold: said by a hound on a winning streak / a long losing run ({n} = how many); at_hot / at_cold: said to one. Streak lines in the ticker use {n} too; ticker.guest announces a guest racer ({a}). A guest's own lines (by, at, ouch) live with the guest (guests.json).
